title: Grateful Dead Live at Woodstock Music on 1969-08-16
lineage: Panasonic SV-3700 > Cardas cable S/PDIF > Edirol UA-5 > analog out > Korg MR-1 DFF @ [1bit/2.8 mhz] Rate Conversion: AudioGate to [24bit/96 khz] Mastering: In WaveLab with L3 Waves Multimaximizer > TLH > Flac

ai_review.summary: Fair audience recording of Woodstock with a monster 45‑minute Turn On Your Love Light, but sound is a bit muddy and uneven
ai_review.review: The show captures the iconic August 16 1969 Woodstock set, highlighted by Pigpen’s marathon 45‑minute rendition of “Turn On Your Lovelight.” Reviewers note the performance isn’t the band’s worst and praise the historic vibe, yet they point out microphone issues and recommend using an EQ to tame the lo‑fi audience mix.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers give moderate-to-high star scores (average ~3.5) and mention a standout performance but also note recording limitations; the mix of positive show comments and technical complaints leads to a mid‑high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Muddy mic capture with occasional distortion; reviewers suggest using EQ to improve clarity. No explicit soundboard source mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Historical Woodstock set with a long, improvisational jam; overall performance is solid but not the band’s pinnacle.
